name: agorapulse
description: Work with your Agorapulse social media management account: report on social performance, draft and schedule posts, read and answer your social inbox, and follow social listening.

interface.longDescription:
Agorapulse is a social media management platform used by marketing teams and agencies to publish, engage, listen and report across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest and Google Business Profile. This plugin connects your Agorapulse account so you can work with your own organizations, workspaces, social profiles and data, with the permissions you already have in Agorapulse.

What you can do:
- Report on performance: audience growth, engagement, impressions, top-performing content, labeled post performance, community management response times and sentiment, with comparison to the previous period.
- Plan and publish: browse your published and scheduled posts and your publishing calendar, save drafts, schedule a post on a profile at a date, edit or delete posts not yet published, and manage calendar notes. A draft is never published on its own, and the assistant asks you to confirm before it schedules, changes or deletes anything.
- Work your social inbox: read comments, private messages, mentions and reviews with their conversation threads, and reply to them after you confirm the message.
- Follow social listening: browse your listening searches, matched mentions, volumes, engagement, sentiment and trending keywords.

Who it is for: social media managers, community managers, marketers and agencies with an Agorapulse account.

Limitations: the plugin only sees the organizations, workspaces and social profiles your account can access. It cannot remove a post already published on a social network, delete or hide inbox items, connect social profiles, or change your subscription. Analytics and listening cover the data Agorapulse collects for your connected profiles and searches.
capabilities: Draft and schedule social media posts
Read and reply to your social inbox
defaultPrompt: How did my Instagram profile perform last month compared to the month before?
Draft a LinkedIn post announcing our next webinar.
Show me the unanswered comments in my inbox from the last 7 days.

positive.description: Setup: use the dedicated reviewer account in Kristell testing org. The verified profile list is Cat Lover Agora (@cat_lover_agora, Instagram), Jessica AP test (@jessica-ap-test, LinkedIn), and Agorapulse Beta TW (@AgorapulseBeta, X). Discover workspace and profile IDs through the tools; do not infer IDs from these names. Before running, verify LinkedIn draft permission, a listening search with data, and sample Instagram analytics and comments. Run in a fresh chat; select the reviewer organization/workspace if asked. Verify discovery and scope selection; compare names, networks and profile UIDs to the reviewer workspace.
positive.prompt: Which social profiles are connected in my Agorapulse workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_organizations, then get_workspaces with the selected returned organizationId, then get_profiles with that organizationId and returned workspaceId. List only returned profiles with their names and networks. Ask the user to select among multiple scopes; never guess IDs or claim profiles not returned.

positive.description: Setup: use the dedicated reviewer account in Kristell testing org. The verified profile list is Cat Lover Agora (@cat_lover_agora, Instagram), Jessica AP test (@jessica-ap-test, LinkedIn), and Agorapulse Beta TW (@AgorapulseBeta, X). Discover workspace and profile IDs through the tools; do not infer IDs from these names. Before running, verify LinkedIn draft permission, a listening search with data, and sample Instagram analytics and comments. Run in a fresh chat; select the reviewer organization/workspace if asked. Use an Instagram profile with data in the last complete calendar month and its preceding month. Record the run date and calendar boundaries before execution.
positive.prompt: How did my Instagram profile perform last month compared to the month before?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve organizationId, workspaceId and the Instagram profileUid through discovery. Pass that profileUid to list_analytics_insights; use a returned metricSet (audience-profile-performance if available) and supported options with get_analytics_insight. Set since/until to the last complete calendar month in YYYY-MM-DD format. Report only returned audience, engagement, impressions and previous-period variations; identify unavailable metrics, and do not invent values. If compact=true, honor its documented zero-valued daily-bucket omission; otherwise do not treat unavailable data as zero.

positive.description: Setup: use the dedicated reviewer account in Kristell testing org. The verified profile list is Cat Lover Agora (@cat_lover_agora, Instagram), Jessica AP test (@jessica-ap-test, LinkedIn), and Agorapulse Beta TW (@AgorapulseBeta, X). Discover workspace and profile IDs through the tools; do not infer IDs from these names. Before running, verify LinkedIn draft permission, a listening search with data, and sample Instagram analytics and comments. Run in a fresh chat; select the reviewer organization/workspace if asked. Use text-only sample content with no attachment or external link. This case writes a draft in the dedicated test workspace; verify the draft in Agorapulse afterwards.
positive.prompt: Save a text-only LinkedIn draft saying exactly: "Join our social media webinar this Thursday." Do not schedule or publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the reviewer organizationId, workspaceId and LinkedIn profileUid through discovery. Call create_draft once for that profileUid with the exact requested text and type=TEXT; omit publishingDate. Confirm a saved draft only when the tool succeeds, quoting its returned identifier when available. Do not call schedule_post or claim the draft was published; verify its saved draft state in Agorapulse. On an error, explain the error without claiming a draft exists.

positive.description: Setup: use the dedicated reviewer account in Kristell testing org. The verified profile list is Cat Lover Agora (@cat_lover_agora, Instagram), Jessica AP test (@jessica-ap-test, LinkedIn), and Agorapulse Beta TW (@AgorapulseBeta, X). Discover workspace and profile IDs through the tools; do not infer IDs from these names. Before running, verify LinkedIn draft permission, a listening search with data, and sample Instagram analytics and comments. Run in a fresh chat; select the reviewer organization/workspace if asked. Provide at least one incoming Instagram comment in the last seven days, plus a private-message item to check that the comment filter excludes it. Record the run timestamp.
positive.prompt: Show me the Instagram comments I received in my inbox over the last 7 days, newest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Instagram profileUid through discovery. Call get_inbox_items with the selected organizationId/workspaceId, profileUids containing only that Instagram profile, since/until covering the requested seven-day period as ISO 8601 timestamps, order=DESC and incoming comment types supported by the schema (such as organicComment, adsComment or reelComment), excluding conversation and outgoing profile replies. Show author, text and timestamp only as returned; disclose pagination or follow returned offsets. Do not send replies or change inbox state.

positive.description: Setup: use the dedicated reviewer account in Kristell testing org. The verified profile list is Cat Lover Agora (@cat_lover_agora, Instagram), Jessica AP test (@jessica-ap-test, LinkedIn), and Agorapulse Beta TW (@AgorapulseBeta, X). Discover workspace and profile IDs through the tools; do not infer IDs from these names. Before running, verify LinkedIn draft permission, a listening search with data, and sample Instagram analytics and comments. Run in a fresh chat; select the reviewer organization/workspace if asked. Use one listening search with matched items and extracted topics in the last seven days. Record the run timestamp; if several searches exist, select the one prepared for review.
positive.prompt: Summarize sentiment and the top topics for our brand in social listening over the last 7 days.
positive.tools_triggered: get_organizations, get_workspaces, get_profiles, get_listening_searches, get_listening_sentiments, get_listening_keywords
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve organizationId/workspaceId and obtain searchId from get_listening_searches. Call get_listening_sentiments and get_listening_keywords with that same searchId and matching ISO 8601 since/until values for the requested seven-day period. Report sentiment and topics supported by returned figures, and distinguish missing data from zero. Do not invent quotes from mentions or claim access to a brand/search not returned.

negative.description: Setup: a chat with onboarding already completed and the reviewer account connected. Connecting a social profile is not supported. Expected: No tool is called for this unsupported request. Explains that social profiles are connected in Agorapulse, and offers to list the profiles already connected. Do not claim the requested action succeeded.
negative.prompt: Connect my new TikTok account to Agorapulse.

negative.description: Setup: a chat with onboarding already completed and the reviewer account connected. Deleting inbox content is not supported. Expected: No tool is called for this unsupported request. Explains that the plugin can read and reply to inbox items but cannot delete or hide them. Do not claim the requested action succeeded.
negative.prompt: Delete all the comments in my Agorapulse inbox.

negative.description: Setup: a chat with onboarding already completed and the reviewer account connected. Subscription changes are not supported. Expected: No tool is called for this unsupported request. Explains that plan changes are not available through the plugin and are managed in Agorapulse, without promoting any plan or linking to a checkout. Do not claim the requested action succeeded.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Agorapulse plan to the next tier.
